narikala.name: Narikala Fortress
narikala.hours: Open-air site, always accessible; best in daylight
narikala.tip: Walk up from Old Town or ride the cable car, then follow the ridge for the best views over the city.

old-town.name: Old Tbilisi (Abanotubani)
old-town.hours: Always open; liveliest in the evening
old-town.tip: Get lost in the lanes around the sulphur baths. Wear shoes that cope with uneven stone.
old-town.best: Morning for photos, evening for atmosphere

trinity-cathedral.name: Holy Trinity Cathedral of Tbilisi
trinity-cathedral.hours: Generally open daily, roughly 08:00–20:00; check on the day
trinity-cathedral.tip: Cover shoulders and knees. It sits high on Elia Hill, so combine it with a walk down to Rike Park.

bridge-of-peace.name: Bridge of Peace
bridge-of-peace.hours: Always open; lights on after dark
bridge-of-peace.tip: Cross at night when the glass canopy is lit. It links Old Town with Rike Park.

chronicles.name: Chronicles of Georgia
chronicles.tip: It is out by the sea reservoir, not central. Take a taxi and ask the driver to wait.

dry-bridge.name: Dry Bridge Market
dry-bridge.price_text: Free to browse; bring cash for buys
dry-bridge.hours: Mainly daytime, roughly 10:00–18:00; busiest weekends; check on the day
dry-bridge.tip: Haggle politely on Soviet-era plates, rugs and jewellery. Bring small notes.

jvari.name: Jvari Monastery
jvari.hours: Generally open daily in daylight hours; check on the day
jvari.tip: It is outside the city near Mtskheta. Pair it with Svetitskhoveli in one half-day trip.

khachapuri.name: Khachapuri (Adjaruli)
khachapuri.price_text: ≈ GEL 10–25 per khachapuri, varies by place
khachapuri.tip: Try the boat-shaped Adjaruli with egg and butter. Stir it together before eating.

kura-river.name: Kura River (Mtkvari) embankment
kura-river.tip: Walk the embankment between the Bridge of Peace and Metekhi for the classic city view.

mtatsminda.name: Mtatsminda Park
mtatsminda.price_text: Park free; funicular and rides cost extra (check on the day)
mtatsminda.tip: Ride the funicular up for the panorama, then walk down through the old streets.

svetitskhoveli.name: Svetitskhoveli Cathedral
svetitskhoveli.hours: Generally open daily in daylight hours; check on the day
svetitskhoveli.tip: It is in Mtskheta, about 30 minutes from Tbilisi. Dress modestly and combine with Jvari.

aerial-tramway.name: Tbilisi Aerial Tramway (Rike Park cable car)
aerial-tramway.price_text: ≈ GEL 2–5 per ride with a metro card; check on the day
aerial-tramway.tip: Buy or top up a Metromoney card first. Ride up to Narikala for the view.

deserter-market.name: Deserter Market (Bazaar)
deserter-market.price_text: Free to enter; pay for what you buy
deserter-market.hours: Roughly 08:00–18:00 daily; check on the day
deserter-market.tip: Come for spices, cheese, churchkhela and fresh produce. Bring cash and small notes.

fabrika.name: Fabrika courtyard
fabrika.price_text: Free to enter; pay for food and drinks
fabrika.tip: A former sewing factory turned hangout with bars, shops and street art. Good for an evening drink.

sololaki-walk.name: Sololaki neighbourhood walk
sololaki-walk.tip: Wander the lanes for Art Nouveau balconies and quiet courtyards. Look up as you walk.

sulphur-baths.name: Abanotubani sulphur baths
sulphur-baths.price_text: ≈ GEL 40–100 for a private room; varies by bathhouse
sulphur-baths.hours: Roughly 08:00–22:00; book ahead for private rooms
sulphur-baths.tip: Book a private room and bring your own towel if you can. Expect a hot, steamy soak.

wine-tasting.name: Georgian wine tasting
wine-tasting.price_text: ≈ GEL 30–80 per tasting; varies by venue
wine-tasting.tip: Ask for qvevri (clay-jar) wines. Book a small tasting rather than a big group tour.

metekhi-viewpoint.name: Metekhi viewpoint
metekhi-viewpoint.tip: A short climb gives you the classic postcard view of Old Town and the river.

rustaveli-walk.name: Rustaveli Avenue walk
rustaveli-walk.tip: Stroll from Freedom Square to the opera and parliament buildings. Stop for coffee on the way.

city-tour.name: Old Town walking tour
city-tour.price_text: ≈ GEL 30–60 or tip-based; check on the day
city-tour.hours: Tours usually run morning and afternoon
city-tour.tip: A guided walk helps you find the hidden courtyards. Confirm the meeting point and price first.
